payload.text: Contract Manufacturing Organization, Beauty & Home Care CMO Bright Innovation Labs Your CMO Innovation Partner As the nation’s most diverse beauty, personal and home care contract manufacturing organization, Bright Innovation Labs formulates and creates products across the entire spectrum of liquids and powders. Whether you are an emerging or already established global brand, we are your true partner from concept to go-to-market. We are here to help you strategically expand your product portfolio. We innovate and deliver to meet all your growing product line needs from day one. Leveraging proprietary technology and R&D innovations, we ensure that when you’re ready to expand, we’re equipped to provide the infrastructure and support you require. Learn More What We Make Trend-Setting, Market-Focused, World-Class Beauty & Skincare Products The beauty sector is in a constant state of evolution and change. What’s in demand today may be outdated tomorrow. We stay one step ahead of these trends, providing you with the competitive edge necessary for growth in a rapidly evolving marketplace. We possess a deep understanding of the latest beauty trends shaping the industry, ranging from textures and ingredients to the environmental impact on packaging and formulation. Did you know? We are one of the largest manufacturers of reactive hair formulations in North America! See What We Make Where We Make It 2 Manufacturing Facilities. 1 Solution. With 35 years of manufacturing experience, we’re ready to serve you. Operating from our facilities in Ohio and Arizona, we specialize in the development and manufacturing of cutting-edge beauty, personal and home care products. Additionally, we offer valuable insights into R&D, innovation, and industry trends. Whether you need single services or full turnkey solutions, our R&D Innovation team is here to support you every step of the way.
